items.zh: Rockstar 的《GTA VI》版本將如何重塑遊戲、串流媒體甚至帶薪休假。《俠盜獵車手 VI》於 11 月 19 日推出，備受期待。它的影響可能會影響創作者、串流媒體、音樂、工作休假、食品配送和旅遊業。

items.title: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
items.en: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?. NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.
items.zh: 既然黃仁勳已經出局，輝達的競爭對手還有機會嗎？NPR 的 Scott Detrow 與人工智慧和半導體研究公司 SemiAnalysis 的 Dylan Patel 討論了黃仁勳離開 Nvidia 的問題，以及這是否為 Nvidia 的競爭對手打開了領域。

items.en: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors. Two Nvidia investors with about $2.13 billion of stock disclosed as of June 30 are calling for a deliberate leadership search after Huang’s resignation.

items.title: These economists say in-person work boosts creativity, but office mandates fall short
items.en: These economists say in-person work boosts creativity, but office mandates fall short. A pair economists argue in a new book that people are more creative and productive when they work together in person. But it's not enough for employers to simply order workers back to the office.
items.zh: 這些經濟學家表示，面對面的工作可以提高創造力，但辦公室的規定卻不夠。兩位經濟學家在一本新書中指出，當人們一起工作時，他們會更有創造力和生產力。但雇主僅僅命令員工返回辦公室是不夠的。

items.en: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home. Eric Trump-backed robot startup Foundation Future Industries has run low on cash and missed payroll, as CEO Sankaet Pathak faces scrutiny over a $4.6 million company loan.

items.en: Family Dollar to Pay $63 Million Settlement for Overcharging Customers. Since 2023, the discount retailer has been overcharging shoppers “millions of dollars” at checkout, according to a complaint filed by federal regulators and 17 states.
